scientific_objectives.primary_objective: Rigorous confirmatory evaluation of Continuous Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) with Dynamic Selective Gating (DSG) across diverse English accents in streaming automatic speech recognition.

confirmatory_population.allocation_rule: Equal sample allocation across all 5 confirmatory strata

exploratory_population.isolation_status: Strictly segregated under exploratory_strata in ConfirmatoryAnalysisReportV15
exploratory_population.confirmatory_family_shielding: Irish English contributes 0 hypotheses to the M=8 family and has zero mathematical influence on confirmatory decisions.

decision_rules.event_a: Static Superiority: Delta_static < 0.00 pp AND Wald cluster-robust t-UCB < 0.00 pp
decision_rules.event_b: SUTA Superiority: Delta_ungated < 0.00 pp AND Wald cluster-robust t-UCB < 0.00 pp
decision_rules.event_c: Per-Accent Safety Guards: Wald cluster-robust t-UCB <= +2.00 pp for each of the 5 confirmatory strata
decision_rules.event_d: Disparity Non-Increase Guard: Stratified cluster bootstrap (B=20,000) 99.375th percentile UCB_D <= 0.00 pp

statistical_acceptance_criteria.monte_carlo_power_acceptance_rule: P_hat_joint >= 0.90 AND LCB_95(P_hat_joint) >= 0.90 from at least S=10,000 Monte Carlo trials with B=20,000 bootstrap replicates.

historical_protocol_verification.prespecification_wording: where LCB_95% is the exact Clopper-Pearson 95% lower confidence bound

option_2_two_sided_lower_endpoint.name: Lower Endpoint of Two-Sided 95% Clopper-Pearson Confidence Interval

monte_carlo_acceptance_reconciliation.recommendation: Adopt Option 1 (One-Sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LCB). The pre-registration specification in commit 8f92b0b explicitly specified '95% lower confidence bound' prior to observing the empirical outcome. Evaluating power adequacy against a directional minimum threshold (P >= 90%) is standardly formulated as a one-sided hypothesis at level alpha = 0.05.

superseded_historical_findings.supersession_rationale: Task 5 uncalibrated power simulation experienced an unintended 0.1733 pp disparity reduction overshoot (-2.1733 pp vs registered -2.0000 pp) due to single-stage probability clipping. Formally superseded by the exact nested-clipping calibrated estimate of 90.58%.

power_assumptions_and_limitations.sensitivity_bottleneck: Event D (Disparity Non-Increase) is the critical sensitivity bottleneck. If physical disparity reduction is only -1.5 pp or -1.0 pp, joint power degrades to 77.5% and 41.7% respectively. Simulated power is conditional on achieving the development target scenario.

gate_reference_design.isolation: Completely separate from confirmatory evaluation speakers. Reserved strictly for system verification and baseline calibration without data leakage.
